channel.title: thecatrave
channel.description: Long-form guides to electronic music, DJ culture, scenes, festivals and the sounds around them.

item.title: Best Electronic Music Festivals in Europe 2027, Compared
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Fourteen festivals compared by sound, scale, setting and 2027 dates, with what is confirmed and what is still unannounced.

item.title: What Is Grime Music? Its Sound, History, Artists and Tracks
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Cold 140 BPM instrumentals, pirate radio, crews and clashes from East London, and the arguments about who started it.

item.title: What Is Acid House? From Chicago's TB-303 to the UK Rave Boom
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: A $40 bass machine, three friends in Chicago, a DJ who played their tape four times in a night, and the British movement that borrowed the name.

item.title: Best Spotify Playlists: 12 Human-Curated Picks
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Twelve playlists with an identifiable point of view, from KEXP and Pitchfork to Four Tet, Bicep and the electronic underground.

item.title: Primavera Sound Barcelona 2027: Dates, Location and Music
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: The Barcelona festival returns to Parc del Fòrum on 3 to 5 June 2027: its waterfront location, scale, music and city programme.

item.title: German Electronic Music History: From Kraftwerk to Techno
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Cologne studios, Düsseldorf electronic pop, Frankfurt trance and the Detroit-Berlin alliance.

item.title: Mysteryland Festival: Where It Is, Its History, and 2027
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: The oldest dance festival in the Netherlands by its own count, on the old Floriade grounds in Haarlemmermeer: when Mysteryland 2027 is, why it skipped 2026, who owns it, and what it plays.

item.title: Sónar Festival Barcelona: History, Music and 2027 Dates
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Three days every June in Barcelona since 1994: where Sónar happens, how a festival of advanced music grew to 150,000 people, who owns it now, OFFSónar, and Sónar 2027.

item.title: Glastonbury Festival: 2027, Fallow Years and Headliners
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Five days most Junes at Worthy Farm in Somerset: when Glastonbury 2027 is, why there was no festival this year, where it is, how big it is, and every headliner by year.

item.title: Lollapalooza Chicago: Location, History and the Music
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Four days every summer in Grant Park, Chicago: where Lollapalooza happens, how it grew from a farewell tour and what plays across its stages.

item.title: What Is Coachella? 2027 Dates, Location and Music
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Two weekends every April at the Empire Polo Club in Indio: when Coachella 2027 is, how long it lasts, how a festival that lost money in 1999 grew, and what plays in the Sahara.

item.title: Untold Festival: Where It Is, How Big, and the Music
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Four days every August in Cluj-Napoca: when Untold 2027 is, where it happens, how a European Youth Capital party reached 500,000 admissions, and what plays past the main stage.

item.title: Ultra Music Festival 2027: Miami Dates, Location and Music
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Ultra returns to Bayfront Park in Miami on 26 to 28 March 2027: the location, scale, history and music beyond the Main Stage.

item.dc:creator: thecatrave

item.title: EDC Las Vegas: What It Is, How Big, and the Music
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Electric Daisy Carnival at the Las Vegas Motor Speedway: where EDC happens, how half a million people a year grew out of a field in Chino, and what plays past kineticFIELD.

item.title: Tomorrowland Festival: Where It Is, How Big, and the Music
item.dc:creator: thecatrave

item.title: Where to Watch Live DJ Sets: Boiler Room, HÖR, NTS and More
item.dc:creator: thecatrave

item.title: Best Electronic Music Clubs in London: History and Where to Go
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: The best electronic music clubs in London now, plus the rooms that shaped acid house, jungle, garage and dubstep.

item.title: Best Clubs in Berlin: The Legends and the Ones Still Open
item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: The rooms that made Berlin a techno city, the famous clubs that closed, and the best clubs in Berlin that are still open.

item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Eighteen sets picked for what happens in them, beside the ten most-watched, counted across 8,206 Boiler Room recordings.

item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: Ten ways to hear something you have not heard before, from community radio to record credits, ordered by how much work they take.

item.dc:creator: thecatrave

item.dc:creator: thecatrave
item.description: From funk breaks and pirate radio to cracked VSTs and modern bass hybrids.
